meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: Claude 会帮你制作一个可交互的幻灯片演示文稿，包含分页、动画片段、分支导航和演讲者备注。输出的是一个可直接运行的网页，不是视频。
howto.when: 当你明确要求制作幻灯片、演示文稿或交互式展示时触发。如果只是提到“演示”或“转换页面”，Claude 会先确认你是否需要 HyperFrames 幻灯片。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于市场规模的幻灯片，包含数据图表。
say.note: Claude 会创建幻灯片并添加分支和备注。

say.text: 把这个网页转换成可交互的幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会保留原网页的设计和交互。

say.text: 在第三页添加一个热点，链接到详细说明页。
say.note: Claude 会在幻灯片中插入可点击的热点。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you create an interactive slideshow with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and presenter mode with speaker notes. Output is a navigable web deck, not a video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation, or interactive deck. For vague requests like 'presentation' or 'convert this page', Claude confirms before proceeding.

say_en.text: Create a slideshow about market sizing with charts.
say_en.note: Claude builds the deck with branches and notes.

say_en.text: Convert this webpage into an interactive slideshow.
say_en.note: Claude preserves original design and interactions.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 3 linking to a detail page.
